1) Clarify the drawdown windows (monthly tranche vs triggered by usage). We want predictable invoicing for external auditors.
2) If we keep the prepay in USD but draw in EUR for EU teams, how do you handle mid-quarter FX adjustments? We need a failsafe for large negative swings.

Attached is the PO (PO 4782). If you can send a short ops runbook and the bank wiring details that match the PO, procurement can route for signature today.

Thanks,
Elena

Subject: Re: Annual prepay drawdown gateways and currency failsafe

Elena — great questions. Summary below and I attached a draft operations runbook and the proposal workbook. Short answers:

- Drawdown model: we support two modes for committed spend — (A) fixed monthly tranche (set $ per month) or (B) dynamic trigger model (draw when remaining credit falls below X% and usage exceeds threshold). Either can be mapped to PO lines. You chose the trigger model on the call; we can document an initial threshold of 20% with monthly floor releases if you prefer predictability.

- FX handling: Redwood invoices and holds the prepay in the invoice currency (USD in your PO). If you want team-level EUR consumption, we supply either (1) tokenized internal transfers with monthly FX reconciliation (we use mid-market FX at month-end + a lockout band to avoid micro adjustments) or (2) a hedged drawdown approach via our payments partner (Fintrax) that fixes conversion for each draw within a configurable tolerance.

Operational asks for procurement:
- Confirm mode A or B
- Confirm PO currency and whether you require monthly EUR reporting
- Signed PO and preferred payment rails (ACH / wire / Fintrax)

I'll loop in Kimberly to validate invoice cadence and Karthik for any SSO/ledger mapping we should reserve.

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Annual prepay drawdown gateways and currency failsafe

Hi Elena — quick from billing ops:

1) If you pick fixed monthly tranche (mode A) we will emit 12 monthly invoices with the PO number on each invoice. Ledger tagging will use the PO + project code you provide.

2) For the trigger model (mode B) we will issue an invoice when a drawdown is executed. We can cap the number of draws per month to 2 to keep AP predictable.

3) FX process: our standard is month-end revaluation using a mid-market rate; we can alternatively switch to per-draw lock-in via Fintrax if you prefer no post-period adjustments. Choosing per-draw lock-in requires Fintrax setup (KYC for beneficiary account) and adds a fixed 0.25% conversion spread.

4) VAT / tax: if Albatross wants net VAT evidence, please include VAT registration numbers for each EU entity. We will attach country-specific invoices with VAT lines as required.

If you confirm mode and FX preference, I will draft the invoice cadence and evidence checklist (sample invoice, SWIFT/wire instructions, Fintrax onboarding checklist).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@albatross.ai>

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay drawdown gateways and currency failsafe

Kim / Rafael — procurement notes: we prefer the trigger model but need a fallback monthly floor to keep our burn forecasting clean. Proposed config: trigger draws when balance < 25% AND expected 7-day consumption > $75k; fallback monthly tranche of $50k. Please confirm you can enforce the two-draw-per-month cap and provide wire instructions that match PO 4782.

Also, we need a simple escalation path if a draw fails (bank reject / FX provider outage). Can you confirm who we call and expected SLAs for retries?

Tom Blake
Procurement Lead | Albatross AI
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@albatross.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@albatross.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay drawdown gateways and currency failsafe

Tom / Elena — we can do that configuration. Operational commitments below: 

- Draw rules: trigger at <25% balance AND projected 7-day usage > $75k. Fallback monthly tranche: $50k on the 1st of each month if balance still below 40%.
- Draw cap: max 2 automated draws per calendar month. Manual ad-hoc draw requests allowed via finance@redwood.com with a 24-hour SLAT.
- FX failover: primary per-draw lock-in (Fintrax). If Fintrax is unavailable, we will hold the draw and notify within 15 minutes; automated retry at +30 minutes and +2 hours; if still failing, Redwood will POST an invoice in USD and queue a credit hold for reconciliation — procurement will be notified and CS will open an incident. Expected incident response SLA for payment failures: initial ack within 30 minutes, engineer escalation within 2 hours, resolution or mitigation plan within 24 hours.

- Escrow / migration: if you decide to move prepay into an escrow (third-party custodian) we support the migration but need 7 business days for ledger reconciliation and an escrow routing confirmation from your legal team.

Kimberly — please send the sample invoice templates, SWIFT/wire details, and the Fintrax onboarding PDF to Tom & Elena so procurement can start KYC. Rafael — I'll add the deal-level mapping to our billing queue.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
